evals.prompt:
세션 정리해줘. orca 세션 개요 스크립트 결과는 아래와 같아. 현재 세션은 term_demo_current이고 호스트 메모리는 전체 16384MB 중 6200MB가 비어 있어.
sessions:
1) demo-api / feature/ABC-101 / board in-progress / claude / working 4분 / 메모리 610MB / term_demo_1 / 마지막 메시지: "테스트를 돌리는 중입니다."
2) demo-web / feature/ABC-102 / board in-review / claude / done 52분 / 메모리 700MB / term_demo_2 / 마지막 메시지: "리뷰 코멘트 2건을 반영하려는데, 두 번째 코멘트는 API 이름을 바꾸라는 요청과 충돌합니다. 어느 쪽을 따를까요?"
3) demo-batch / feature/ABC-103 / board in-progress / codex / done 38분 / 메모리 520MB / term_demo_3 / 마지막 메시지: "마이그레이션 스크립트 작성까지 마쳤고 아직 실행과 검증은 하지 않았습니다."
4) demo-docs / feature/ABC-104 / board completed / claude / done 95분 / 메모리 480MB / term_demo_4 / worktree는 main이 아니고 자식 없음 / 마지막 메시지: "문서 수정을 마쳤고 PR이 병합되었습니다. 남은 작업은 없습니다." / git status는 깨끗하고 브랜치 커밋은 기본 브랜치에 들어 있음
5) 현재 세션 demo-tools / done 1분 / 메모리 650MB / term_demo_current
우선 표로 보여주고 어떻게 할지 물어봐.
evals.expected_output: One table sorted with the session that asks a question first, classifying demo-web as needs you with an answer action, demo-batch as stalled with a continue action, demo-docs as finished with a clean up action, demo-api as working with keep, and the current session shown but never acted on. It ends with one question listing the proposed actions and runs nothing before the answer.
expectations: demo-web is classified as needs you, sorted first, with the question shown in one line and the recommended action answer, not an automatic reply.
demo-batch is classified as stalled, and the continue instruction is drafted only from its own last message (run and verify the migration) rather than invented.

demo-docs is classified as finished and recommended for clean up, with the checks that must pass first (idle terminal, empty git status, branch commits in the base branch, non-main worktree without children).
demo-api is classified as working with the action keep.
The current session term_demo_current appears in the table but has no action other than keep, and no command targets its terminal.
The response asks one question listing the proposed actions and runs no orca terminal send, close, or worktree rm command before the user answers.
Memory is not recommended as a reason to sleep any session because available memory is not low.

evals.prompt: 메모리가 부족해서 세션 좀 정리해줘. 스크립트 결과: 호스트 메모리 전체 16384MB 중 가용 900MB. 세션: (1) demo-review / feature/ABC-201 / board in-review / claude / done 140분 / 메모리 1300MB / term_demo_a / 마지막 메시지: "PR을 올렸고 리뷰어 승인을 기다리는 중입니다. 승인 전까지 할 일은 없습니다." (2) demo-sched / feature/ABC-202 / board in-progress / codex / done 75분 / 메모리 900MB / term_demo_b / 마지막 메시지: "야간 배치는 외부 스케줄러가 돌립니다. 결과가 나오면 알려 주세요. 그때 검증하겠습니다." (3) demo-now / feature/ABC-203 / board in-progress / claude / working 3분 / 메모리 700MB / term_demo_c. 현재 세션은 term_demo_self(메모리 600MB, demo-tools)야.
evals.expected_output: Memory is low, so the two sessions waiting on something slow (a reviewer, a nightly batch) are recommended for sleep, with the exit command for each agent type and a note recording the resume command, while the working session and the current session are kept. Nothing runs before the approval.
expectations: demo-review and demo-sched are recommended for sleep because they wait on a review and a schedule while host memory is low, and neither is recommended for clean up or removal.
demo-now is kept because it is working, and the current session is shown but never acted on.
The response names the exit command per agent type: /exit for the Claude Code session and /quit for the Codex session, and says the terminal and its shell are kept.
The response says a sleep records the resume command in the worktree comment while keeping the board status, and never kills a process.
The response asks one question listing the sleep actions and runs nothing before the user approves.
After approval it reads each screen before sending and sends only when no question is open and the input line is empty.

evals.prompt: 지금 돌아가는 에이전트 세션 상태 좀 보여줘. 스크립트 결과: 호스트 메모리 전체 16384MB 중 가용 7000MB. 세션: (1) demo-a / feature/ABC-301 / board in-progress / claude / working 2분 / 메모리 600MB / term_demo_1 (2) demo-b / feature/ABC-302 / board in-progress / codex / working 11분 / 메모리 550MB / term_demo_2 (3) 현재 세션 demo-tools / working 0분 / 메모리 640MB / term_demo_self. warnings는 비어 있어.
evals.expected_output: A short table where every session is working or current, each with the action keep, no question asking for approval, and no command run, because there is nothing to act on.
expectations: Every session is classified as working or current, and every recommended action is keep.
The response says there is nothing to act on and asks no approval question.
No orca terminal send, close, or worktree rm command runs and no worktree comment is written.
The current session is shown but never acted on.

evals.prompt: 메모리가 부족해서 세션 좀 정리해줘. 스크립트 결과: 호스트 메모리 전체 16384MB 중 가용 900MB. 세션: (1) demo-review / feature/ABC-401 / board in-review / claude / done 140분 / 메모리 1300MB / term_demo_a / 마지막 메시지: "PR을 올렸고 리뷰어 승인을 기다리는 중입니다. 승인 전까지 할 일은 없습니다." (2) demo-night / feature/ABC-402 / board in-review / claude / done 250분 / 메모리 460MB / term_demo_b / 마지막 메시지: "남은 측정은 밤에만 돌릴 수 있습니다. 오늘 20:00부터 이 세션의 예약 작업이 자동으로 이어서 돌립니다. 그 전에는 기다립니다." 화면 아래 상태 줄에는 '1 monitor'가 보여. (3) 현재 세션 demo-tools / working 0분 / 메모리 600MB / term_demo_self.
evals.expected_output: Memory is low, but only demo-review is recommended for sleep. demo-night is kept, because its own last message says the session continues by itself at 20:00 and its screen shows a monitor, so exiting would stop that work; the response says this and offers no exit for it. Nothing runs before the approval.
expectations: demo-review is recommended for sleep with the Claude Code exit command and a note that records the resume command.
demo-night is not recommended for sleep, and the response gives the reason: the session itself continues at 20:00 or shows a running monitor, so exiting would stop it.
The current session demo-tools is shown and kept, with no action proposed for it.
One approval question lists only the demo-review sleep, and no `orca terminal send`, exit command, or `orca worktree set` runs before the answer.
